atoms.text: The Rollinson family live in Cornwall and are very active and adventurous. Every summer holiday they go on holiday close to their town. For this year’s holiday, they’ve decided to paddle down the Helford River in an inflatable raft.

instruction.text: Select the picture that matches the story best.

atoms.a: Choose the sentence that describes the characters best.

b.sound: One of the kids is on a red raft going through some rapids.
All of the family members are wearing many layers of clothing but look as if they are freezing.

atoms.a: Choose the sentence that describes the setting best.

b.sound: The river is surrounded by big rocks and is heading downstream.
The river is surrounded by big old trees with branches hanging into the water.

instruction.text: Find the sentence that describes the mood of the picture best.

atoms.b: After_a_long_and_exhausting_day_of_paddling_on_the_river,_they_set_up_their_tents_on_a_camping_ground_next_to_the_water. ((Being outside on a warm and sunny day always brings them a lot of joy.)) They_can’t_wait_for_their_next_adventure.
atoms.sound: After a long and exhausting day of paddling on the river, they set up their tents on a camping ground next to the water. Being outside on a warm and sunny day always brings them a lot of joy. They can’t wait for their next adventure.
